Page or endpoint: Google Sheets retries duplicate responses and retain removed columns
Role: Applicable isolated QA identities; see bug entry
Expected: an explicitly approved server-only RLS job table and two SECURITY INVOKER RPCs serialize/coalesce requests per form. Sync replaces canonical saved rows and headers in one atomic Google batch, paginates database reads, keeps values as literal strings and reports queued requests honestly. Provider errors return a bounded generic message, never a credential-bearing request object. Failed/unfinished jobs retain pending work for the next retry/Resync all. The API runtime is bounded to 120 seconds and ownership leases to five minutes.
Actual: actual QA Sheet contains the same response twice after retry; removing 26 questions leaves 32 header cells instead of 6 because the old clear range ends at Z.
Evidence: BUG-024-coordination-local.json, BUG-024-sheets-after.json, BUG-024-table-crud.txt, BUG-024-fresh-schema.txt, BUG-024-api-contracts.txt and BUG-024 gate logs.
